fields.value: CLUMondo land system projections for European forest management scenarios

dsDescriptionValue.value: This dataset contains 1km resolution outputs for four stakeholder-informed European forest management scenarios (2020–2050) generated using the CLUMondo land system model. These results represent the spatial implications of diverse forest management pathways across Europe and are currently restricted pending publication. Detailed technical specifications are provided in the attached README.txt file, along with a legend.qml file for data styling. For further information regarding the scenario implementation, methodology, or access inquiries, please contact the author directly.

datasetVersion.citation: Scherpenhuijzen, Niek; West, Thales; Di Marzo, Daniel; Verburg, Peter, 2026, "CLUMondo land system projections for European forest management scenarios", https://doi.org/10.34894/RHWPLS, DataverseNL, V1
